title: The Twins Swap Hats
skyStory: The moon skips into Gemini, sixty-nine percent lit and talking a mile a minute. Gemini is the twins, and tonight they cannot decide which of them gets to wear the moon as a hat, so they take turns every eleven minutes. Mercury is timing them with a stopwatch. Saturn has requested a quieter sky. The twins have requested Saturn lighten up.

reading: Gemini gives your tongue rocket boots. Words come easy today, maybe too easy. You will find yourself explaining something with three metaphors where one would do, and somewhere around the second metaphor your listener will start to glaze. Trim it. The best sentence is the one you finish early.

This afternoon, two very different people will ask for your help at the same moment, and you will be tempted to clone yourself. You cannot. Gemini is teasing. Help one fully, then the other, and enjoy discovering that your Life Path 3 gift works even better one conversation at a time. The [[Two of Wands]] says choose your first door.
joel.mission: Explain one complicated thing today in a single sentence of fifteen words or fewer, and count them proudly.
joel.omen: Two people wearing nearly identical outfits. You are about to hear the same good idea from two directions.
joel.stoneWhy: an anchor for a chatty moon

reading: Your stories have a twin today. Whatever you tell someone this morning will come back to you this afternoon, retold by somebody else, slightly wrong and much funnier. Do not correct it. The new version has better hand gestures than you would expect from a stranger.

Evening brings a lovely chill, sharp enough to see your breath maybe, if you go out after dark. The equinox is tomorrow and the sky is getting ready to balance its books. Write two short lists before bed: what summer gave you and what you hope autumn brings. Keep both on the fridge.
nancy.mission: Write a two-column list tonight, summer gave me and autumn will bring, with at least three items each.
nancy.omen: Hearing your own story retold by someone else. Your words travelled farther than you realized.

together.text: Swap roles for one conversation: Joel tells a story Nancy style, with grand hand gestures and patient pauses, and Nancy tells one Joel style, fast, three ideas at once. Gemini judges. Gemini cannot stop laughing, which is a pass.
